issues.detail: Hebrew has 'עַד עַזָּה' (as far as Gaza), but Vietnamese renders 'cho đến Ách-cáp' (as far as Achzib/Achshaph), swapping Gaza for a different place name.
Vietnamese adds 'Bết Nê-ên' (Beth Neein/Beth Nehel) which is not present in the Hebrew text; the Hebrew only mentions Kadesh-barnea, Gaza, Goshen, and Gibeon.
